fields.JP:
独房探索を開始したが、
やはり一筋縄ではいかないようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if it won't be as
easy as expected to 
search the cells.
fields.EN:
It seems as if it won't be as
easy as expected to 
search the cells.

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（磁力の栓抜き）

壁にはまった鉄の栓、
何かの力で引っ張れないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
A metal piece stuck 
in the wall... I wonder if 
I can pull it out somehow...
fields.EN:
A metal piece stuck 
in the wall... I wonder if 
I can pull it out somehow...

fields.JP: ジェイルには衝撃を与えると爆散する木の実があるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's a nut that 
explodes with impact.
fields.EN:
There's a nut that 
explodes with impact.

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（穴の開いた床）

穴を塞ぐものがあれば、
先に進めそうなのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should be able to move onward 
if I can only find something to 
plug the hole with.
fields.EN:
I should be able to move onward 
if I can only find something to 
plug the hole with.

fields.JP:
金属の塊が道を塞いでいる。
塊を動かす力さえあれば
fields.LOCALIZED:
A huge mass of metal is
blocking the way. If only I
had something to move it with.
fields.EN:
A huge mass of metal is
blocking the way. If only I
had something to move it with.

fields.JP:
溝の先の宝箱、
何か別の方法で取れないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
There has to be a way to
get the treasure beyond 
the rift...
fields.EN:
There has to be a way to
get the treasure beyond 
the rift...

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（物が乗ると開く）
人や物が乗ることで扉が開くようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like the portal will
open when something is
on the gimmick.
fields.EN:
It looks like the portal will
open when something is
on the gimmick.

fields.JP: 噴き上がる炎を消すことはできないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't there a way 
I can douse the flames?
fields.EN:
Isn't there a way 
I can douse the flames?

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（アイスを置く扉）

この扉の色は
一体何に関係しているのだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there any meaning to
the portal's color?
fields.EN:
Is there any meaning to
the portal's color?

fields.JP:
向こう岸に渡りたいが、
飛び越えるのは難しそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to get across the
water, but it's too far to
jump...
fields.EN:
I want to get to the other side,
but it looks too far to jump.

fields.JP:
水が流れ続けて通れない、
水を止めれないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to find a way to stop 
the flow to move onward...
fields.EN:
I have to find a way to stop 
the flow to move onward...

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（対岸のレバー）

レバーが遠くて届かない、
何か長いものはないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't reach the lever...
I need something long
that can reach it.
fields.EN:
I can't reach the lever...
I need something long
that can reach it.

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（ぶら下がり）
長物があれば、可動装置に届くのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I had something long 
to reach the device with...
fields.EN:
If only I had something long 
to reach the device with...

fields.JP:
この扉はとてもじゃないが
素手で開くことができない
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way 
I can open this door with 
my bare hands.
fields.EN:
There's no way 
I can open this door with 
my bare hands.

fields.JP:
火の上を通した物には、
一瞬にして火が点くようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anything that goes over the
fire will light up in an 
instant.
fields.EN:
Anything that goes over the
fire will light up in an 
instant.

fields.JP: 封印の札も火にはかなわないようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems the seal tags can't
withstand fire.
fields.EN:
It seems the seal tags can't
withstand fire.

fields.JP:
小さな鍵穴に、
普通の鍵を挿す方法はないだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
There has to be a way
of getting the key through
this tiny keyhole...
fields.EN:
There has to be a way
of getting the key through
this tiny keyhole...

fields.JP:
遠くを狙える道具があれば、
先に進めそうなのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I could move forward
if I just had something that
could shoot from a distance...
fields.EN:
I think I could move forward
if I just had something that
could shoot from a distance...

fields.JP:
歩いていては、
どうしても扉が閉まってしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Walking seems to trigger the
shutoff of the portal.
fields.EN:
If I walk, the door always
closes before I can get through.

fields.JP:
凶暴な植物には、
必ず対になる心臓があるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Vicious plants have a heart
somewhere that can be 
targeted.
fields.EN:
Vicious plants have a heart
somewhere that can be 
targeted.

fields.JP:
扉を通る際に無数の手に襲われた。
危険な扉だ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was attacked by numerous hands 
when going through...
fields.EN:
I was attacked by numerous hands 
when going through...

fields.JP:
取っ手を掴む為の
長い何かがあればいいのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I had something long to 
grab the handle with...
fields.EN:
If only I had something long to 
grab the handle with...

fields.JP: この扉は５つの宝石が鍵となるようだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like 5 gems are
needed to open this portal.
fields.EN:
It looks like 5 gems are
needed to open this portal.

fields.JP:
素早く通り抜けることで、
足元が崩れずに済んだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Running through helped me get
across safely.
fields.EN:
Running through helped me get
across safely.

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（トランポリン＋）

走りながら使用すると、
高い跳躍力が得られた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I discovered I can leap
better when used while running.
fields.EN:
I discovered I can leap
better when used while running.

fields.JP: 拾ったメモ（跳ね返し扉）

歩いて通ると、
大きな痛手を受けてしまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Walking across was a bad move... 
That hurt a lot.
fields.EN:
Walking across was a bad move... 
That hurt a lot.

fields.JP:
ジェイルにある物質は、
鋭利な刃物で切れるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Objects within the Jail
can be severed with a
sharp enough blade.
fields.EN:
Objects within the Jail
can be severed with a
sharp enough blade.

fields.JP:
扉の放電を止めるには、
供給源を断ち切るしかない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Need to stop whatever's
electrifying the portal...
fields.EN:
To stop the door's electrical discharge,
we have to cut off its power source.

fields.JP:
この溝を飛び越えるには、
規格外の跳躍力が必要だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to need something
that can help me leap
across this rift.
fields.EN:
I'm going to need something
that can help me leap
across this rift.

fields.JP:
スイッチで可視化できる、
透明の床を発見した
fields.LOCALIZED:
Suddenly a switch came on, and
I could see everything!
fields.EN:
I found an invisible floor that
can be made visible with a
switch.

fields.JP: 水泡の中に神秘的な物体を見ることができた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I saw something divine
inside the bubble.
fields.EN:
I saw a mysterious object
inside the bubble.

fields.JP:
ジェイルが吐き出す結晶
同じ場所で採取しても構造が異なるので
研究材料としては面白いものらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
A crystal generated by the
Jail. It can be found in
multiple forms.
fields.EN:
A crystal produced by the Jail.
Even those gathered in the same place
have different structures, making them
interesting research material.

fields.JP:
メニューの『スキルカスタム』では、
スキルの新規習得・強化・セットができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can learn, strengthen, and set Skills under the
Custom Skills menu.
fields.EN:
You can learn, strengthen, and set Skills under the
Customize Skills menu.

fields.JP:
属性は『火、風、土、水』の4種類あり、
敵の弱点を突くと多くダメージを与えられます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use the four elements - Fire, Air, Earth, and
Water - to attack an enemy's weak point.
fields.EN:
Use the four elements - Fire, Wind, Earth, and
Water - to attack an enemy's weak point.

fields.JP:
各血式少女の固有の『キャラクタースキル』は、
ステータスで確認できます。
fields.LOCALIZED: View each Blood Maiden's Character Skill in their stats.
fields.EN: View each Blood Maiden's Character Skill in their stats.

fields.JP:
ジャック、ジュウ、くららは、戦闘中に何度も気絶すると、
戦闘不能になり行動できなくなります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, Toh, and Clara will be KO'd if they are stunned too many 
times in battle.
fields.EN:
Jack, Juu, and Clara will be KO'd if they are stunned too many
times in battle.

fields.JP:
ライブラリでは、依頼や敵の詳細情報、
チュートリアルなどを確認できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view work orders, enemy data, tutorials,
and more in the Library.
fields.EN:
You can view work orders, enemy data, tutorials,
and more in the Library.

fields.JP:
装備品の強化や職業変更、ブラッドファームに
必要な『血晶』は、メルヒェンを倒すと手に入ります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Crystals help strengthen equipment and allow you to
switch jobs. They can be obtained by defeating 
Marchens.
fields.EN:
Blood Crystals are used to strengthen equipment, to
change jobs, and for the Blood Farm. They can be
obtained by defeating Marchens.

fields.JP:
かごめかごめ効果はスキルや武器の「血走り属性」が
付いていると発生する可能性があります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Kagome-Kagome effect may take effect when
you use a Skill or weapon with a Bloodshot
modifier on them.
fields.EN:
The Kagome-Kagome effect may take effect when
you use a Skill or weapon with a Bloodshot
modifier on them.

fields.JP:
クリティカル予告は「コンボ」を
重ねることで発生しやすくなります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The more combos you do, the more likely a
Critical Notice will occur.
fields.EN:
The more combos you do, the more likely a
Critical Notice will occur.

fields.JP:
ダンジョン内移動中は#Icon[5]で短縮操作を
行う事ができます。

敵の弱点を突くと『血しぶき』が発生し、
『返り血アイコン』が少しずつ満たされます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you attack an enemy's weak point, their blood
splatters, filling the Blood Splatter meter.
fields.EN:
If you attack an enemy's weak point, their blood
splatters, filling the Blood Splatter meter.

fields.JP:
『返り血アイコン』がＭＡＸまで溜まると、
強力な『ジェノサイドモード』に変身できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
When the Blood Splatter meter is maxed, you can enter
Massacre mode.
fields.EN:
When the Blood Splatter meter is maxed, you can enter
Genocide mode.

fields.JP:
『オーバーキル』を発生させると、
血式少女全員が血しぶきを浴びるほか、
敵が血晶を必ずドロップします。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Overkilling will splatter blood on all Blood Maidens
and force Blood Crystals to drop.
fields.EN:
Overkilling will splatter blood on all Blood Maidens
and force Blood Crystals to drop.

fields.JP:
血式少女の返り血を『舐める』ことで、
癒し効果のある『魂血スキル』が発動します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can activate a Blood Soul Skill by licking the
splattered blood on a Blood Maiden, which has healing
or buffing effects.
fields.EN:
You can activate a Blood Soul Skill by licking the
splattered blood on a Blood Maiden, which has healing
or buffing effects.

fields.JP:
スイッチなどで扉を開いた時、マップを見れば
どこの扉が開いたかわかります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can check your mini map to see which portals
are open and closed.
fields.EN:
After opening a door with a switch, check the map
to see which door opened.

fields.JP:
『虐殺鬼ごっこ』から逃れるためには、
ナイトメアをできるだけ引き離しましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
In order to escape a Chase, you will need to run
as far away as possible from the Nightmare.
fields.EN:
In order to escape a Chase, you will need to run
as far away as possible from the Nightmare.

fields.JP:
ナイトメアに追い詰められたら戦闘を挑み、
部位を破壊するか、ダメージを蓄積させノックダウンさせましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If caught by a Nightmare, you will need to destroy a
part of its body during battle to knock it down.
fields.EN:
If caught by a Nightmare, you will need to destroy a
part of its body during battle or damage it
enough to knock it down.

fields.JP:
ナイトメアの部位を破壊した上で逃げ切ると、
普段よりも良いアイテムを入手できます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you are able to run away after knocking the
Nightmare down, you can obtain better items than usual.
fields.EN:
If you are able to run away after knocking the
Nightmare down, you can obtain better items than usual.

fields.JP:
オプションでは色々な細かい設定ができるので、
一度覗いてみよう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can make various tweaks and adjustments
through the Options menu.
fields.EN:
You can make various tweaks and adjustments
through the Options menu.

fields.JP:
感染付き状態異常はターン開始時に
隣のキャラクターに状態異常が感染することがあります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ailments that are classified as Infections have a chance
of infecting adjacent characters with the ailment
at the beginning of each Turn.
fields.EN:
Ailments that are classified as Infections have a chance
of infecting adjacent characters with the ailment
at the beginning of each Turn.

fields.JP:
状態異常の猛毒は「毒」と
同じアイテムで打ち消すことができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can cure Heavy Poison using any means used
to cure Poison.
fields.EN:
You can cure Heavy Poison using any means used
to cure Poison.

fields.JP: 【ブラッドスケルターモード】

返り血アイコンが濁ったままＭＡＸになると、
『ブラッドスケルターモード』に変身し、
敵味方関係なく攻撃してしまいます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Blood Splatter meter is maxed while muddled, you
can enter Blood Skelter mode, where the character will
attack enemies and allies.
fields.EN:
If the Blood Splatter meter is maxed while muddled, you
can enter Blood Skelter mode, where the character will
attack enemies and allies.

fields.JP:
ジェイルの欲求を満たすと、
ジェイルボーナスが発生し恩恵が得られます。
fields.LOCALIZED: Fulfilling the Jail's desire will impart a Jail Bonus.
fields.EN: Fulfilling the Jail's desire will impart a Jail Bonus.

fields.JP:
オプションでジェイルボーナスの一連の操作を
自動化することができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can fully automate the Jail Bonus system
via Options.
fields.EN:
You can fully automate the Jail Bonus system
via Options.

fields.JP:
食欲を満たすには『血しぶきを発生させる』、
性欲は『エモーションポイントなどを調べる』、
睡眠欲は『ジェイル睡眠中にノーダメージ』。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Splatters satisfy Hunger. Finding Emotion
Points satisfies Libido. Winning battles without taking
damage (while the Jail is sleeping) satisfies Sleep.
fields.EN:
Blood Splatters satisfy Hunger. Finding Emotion
Points satisfies Libido. Winning battles without taking
damage (while the Jail is sleeping) satisfies Sleep.

fields.JP:
月アイコンと同じ色の欲求を満たすと、
普段よりゲージが多く溜まります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the desire that's the same color as the Moon icon is
fulfilled, the gauge fills faster than usual.
fields.EN:
If the desire that's the same color as the Moon icon is
fulfilled, the gauge fills faster than usual.

fields.JP:
装備品は、血晶を使用して強化できます。
必要な血晶は、装備品によって異なります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Equipment can be strengthened using Blood Crystals. The
Blood Crystals required depends on the equipment.
fields.EN:
Equipment can be strengthened using Blood Crystals. The
Blood Crystals required depends on the equipment.

fields.JP:
探索中、ジェイルが気まぐれで
欲求ゲージを増減させることがあります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
During exploration, the Jail will act on a whim and lessen the 
desire gauge.
fields.EN:
During exploration, the Jail may act on a whim and
increase or decrease a desire gauge.

fields.JP:
アイテムが所持数の限界に達したら、
部屋の『格納庫』に預けましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you have too many items, you can keep them in
Storage inside your room.
fields.EN:
If you have too many items, you can keep them in
Storage inside your room.

fields.JP:
全てのエリアは、謎の球体でつながっており
行き来することが出来ます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
All areas are connected. If you find the orb, be sure to
check it out.
fields.EN:
All areas are connected by mysterious orbs,
which can be used to travel between them.

fields.JP:
血液残量は、戦闘中の
『造血』コマンドで増やすことができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remaining Blood can be increased in battle using the
Reload command.
fields.EN:
Remaining Blood can be increased in battle using the
Create Blood command.

fields.JP:
研究室の『スキル枠拡張』で、
セットできるスキルの数を増やせます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
With the Expand Slot in the Laboratory, you can
 increase the amount of skills you set.
fields.EN:
Use Expand Skill Slots in the Laboratory to increase
the number of skills you can set.

fields.JP:
『職業変更』を行うことで、ステータスや
習得できるスキルが変化します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Changing jobs will alter both the character's stats and
the Skills that can be learned.
fields.EN:
Changing jobs will alter both the character's stats and
the Skills that can be learned.

fields.JP:
『職業権利』は、キャラクターのレベルを
５レベル上げることで取得できます。
fields.LOCALIZED: Gain Job Rights by raising levels by 5.
fields.EN: Gain Job Rights every 5 character levels.

fields.JP:
ダンジョン内で#Icon[24]を押すと
ブラッドファームが起動できます。
敵が強いと思ったらブラッドファームをしましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press #Icon[24] in cell areas to access the
Blood Farm. Visit the Blood Farm when you
feel overwhelmed by enemy forces.
fields.EN:
Press #Icon[24] in dungeons to access the Blood Farm.
Use the Blood Farm when enemies feel too strong.

fields.JP:
ブラッドファームで植えた血花は「血投げ」を
行うことでレアなものが生まれやすい。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Flowers are grown at Blood Farms,
and covering them with blood with Blood Toss
increases the odds of obtaining rare items.
fields.EN:
Blood Flowers are grown at Blood Farms,
and covering them with blood with Blood Toss
increases the odds of obtaining rare items.

fields.JP:
ユ血スキル、装備スキルは重ねて装備することで、
効果が強力になっていきます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Similar Blood Pack Skills and equipped Skills can
be combined, which increases the Skill's effect.
fields.EN:
Similar Blood Pack Skills and equipped Skills can
be combined, which increases the Skill's effect.

fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター中の相手を
「抱きとめる」ことで被害を自分だけに向けることができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Embracing" someone in Blood Skelter
transfers their aggression to the hugger.
fields.EN:
Embracing someone in Blood Skelter directs the harm
only toward you.

fields.JP:
ジェイルの機嫌が悪くなっていくと、
敵が強くなっていきます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The enemies will become stronger as the
Jail's mood worsens.
fields.EN:
The enemies will become stronger as the
Jail's mood worsens.

fields.JP:
『血式退化』すると、レベルが下がる代わりに
ＣＰやステータス上昇ボーナスが得られます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Devolution lowers your level in exchange for
gaining CP and stat boosts.
fields.EN:
Blood Devolution lowers your level in exchange for
gaining CP and stat boosts.

fields.JP:
インテリアを血式少女にプレゼントすると、
部屋に置かれているインテリアも変化します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Giving an interior item to a Blood Maiden will change
the appearance of her room.
fields.EN:
Giving an interior item to a Blood Maiden will change
the appearance of her room.

fields.JP:
【ワンダーホール】は、探索中でのセーブ、
拠点へ戻ることができる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Rabbit Hole is used to create saves and to escape
from dungeons.
fields.EN:
Wonder Hole lets you save while exploring and
return to base.

fields.JP:
【ボディニッパー】は、
金網などを切ることができる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED: The Body Nipper is used to sever chains and objects.
fields.EN:
The Body Nipper is used to cut wire fences and similar
obstacles.

fields.JP:
【ポイズンボム】は、特定の壁を壊したり
植物を腐らせたりできる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Poison Bomb is used to destroy walls and rot away
vegetation.
fields.EN:
The Poison Bomb is used to destroy walls and rot away
vegetation.

fields.JP:
【ローズアロー】は、遠くにあるスイッチを
衝撃で押したりできる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Rose Arrow is used to activate switches from a
distance.
fields.EN:
The Rose Arrow is used to activate switches from a
distance.

fields.JP:
【プチプリンセス】は、
特定のアイテムを小さくできる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Tiny Princess is used to scale the size of certain
items.
fields.EN:
The Tiny Princess is used to shrink certain
items.

fields.JP:
【１２ダッシュ】は、１２秒間、
自分達の移動速度を上昇させる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Twelve Dash is used to speed your party's movement
in the dungeon for 12 seconds.
fields.EN:
The Twelve Dash is used to speed your party's movement
in the dungeon for 12 seconds.

fields.JP:
【タケプロテクター】は、１０秒間、
トラップのダメージを無効化できる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Bamboo Guard is used to nullify damage from traps
for 10 seconds.
fields.EN:
The Bamboo Guard is used to nullify damage from traps
for 10 seconds.

fields.JP:
【ブレッドポータル】は、
歩きでは行けない場所にワープする能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Bread Portal is used to warp to areas that can't be
reached on foot.
fields.EN:
The Bread Portal is used to warp to areas that can't be
reached on foot.

fields.JP:
【ヘアー！】は、遠くの宝箱を開けたり、
何かをつかむ必要がある時に使える能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hair Flair is used to open treasure chests from a
distance, and to grab things out of reach.
fields.EN:
Hair! is used to open treasure chests from a
distance, and to grab things out of reach.

fields.JP:
【磁力ピッコロ】は、
遠くの物を引き寄せることができる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Magnetic Piccolo is used to draw things closer
to the party.
fields.EN:
The Magnetic Piccolo is used to draw things closer
to the party.

fields.JP:
【バンブーウィーバー】は、
竹編みの物体を生成し穴をふさぐ能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use the Bamboo Weaver to clog holes by weaving bamboo 
together.
fields.EN:
Use the Bamboo Weaver to clog holes by weaving bamboo 
together.

fields.JP:
【フローズンティアー】は、
氷の冷たさで炎を消すなどの能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED: Use the Frozen Tear to douse flames.
fields.EN: Use the Frozen Tear to douse flames.

fields.JP:
【エアーヒューマン】は、
存在感を薄くしてセンサー系ギミックを素通りできる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED: Make yourself invisible to pass through sensors undetected.
fields.EN:
Air Human reduces your presence so you can pass
through sensor-type gimmicks undetected.

fields.JP:
【センリアイ】は、
ジェイル内のギミックのヒントを見ることのできる能力です。
探索に行き詰ったら調べてみましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Senri Eye grants you hints to progress through Gimmicks.
Use in a pinch.
fields.EN:
Senri Eye grants you hints to progress through Gimmicks.
Use in a pinch.

fields.JP:
【ジェノフィア】は、
強い炎を出し火を付けたり氷や水を蒸発させる能力です。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Genofire to evaporate ice and light candles
 by engulfing them in flames.
fields.EN:
Use Genofire to evaporate ice and light candles
 by engulfing them in flames.

fields.JP:
穢れはメアリガンを用いることで
浄化されます。
fields.LOCALIZED: Use the Mary Gun to purify Corruption.
fields.EN: Use the Mary Gun to purify Corruption.

fields.JP:
『ジェイル』は三大欲求を持つ生命体で、
擬態により監獄全体を自らの体としています。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail is a living organism that possesses three
desires. It uses mimicry to control itself.
fields.EN:
The Jail is a living organism with three desires.
Through mimicry, it makes the entire prison its body.

fields.JP:
月の色はジェイルの欲求に応じて変化します。
白は食欲、青は睡眠欲、赤は性欲です。
色によって上昇しやすい三大欲求がわかります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moon's color changes depending on the Jail's
desire. White represents Hunger, blue represents
Sleep, and red represents Libido.
fields.EN:
The moon's color changes depending on the Jail's
desire. White represents Hunger, blue represents
Sleep, and red represents Libido.

fields.JP:
核の破壊は、ジェイルの成長を促進させます。
さらに、ナイトメアの不死性を取り除きます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Destroying a core matures the Jail. It also makes it
possible for you to kill the Nightmare associated with
it.
fields.EN:
Destroying a core matures the Jail. It also makes it
possible for you to kill the Nightmare associated with
it.

fields.JP:
ジェイルマネージでは『ジェイルピース』を使い、
ジェイルのルーレットをある程度定めることができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Jail Pieces in Control Jail to set the roulette
to your favor.
fields.EN:
In Jail Manage, use Jail Pieces to control
the Jail's roulette to a certain extent.

fields.JP:
「トライジェイル」で縛りを設定することで、
お金や経験値等が多く貰えます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Trial increases the difficulty, but in turn
rewards you with more Gold and EXP.
fields.EN:
Setting restrictions in TriJail rewards you with
more Gold, EXP, and other benefits.

fields.JP:
エンカウントアップ・ダウンアイテムは
重ね掛けすることで効果が上昇します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Items and effects that affects the encounter rate
work cumulatively to further increase its effects.
fields.EN:
Items and effects that affects the encounter rate
work cumulatively to further increase its effects.

fields.JP: お金がない時は使用しない武器などを売ってみましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED: Sell seldom or unused weapons when low on money.
fields.EN: Sell seldom or unused weapons when low on money.

fields.JP:
弱点属性を突くことが戦闘の基本です。
弱点を連続で突くと戦闘がどんどん有利になります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hitting an enemy's weak point is the key
to victory. Use elements and ailments to
overpower foes in battle.
fields.EN:
Targeting elemental weaknesses is the basis of battle.
Hitting weaknesses repeatedly will increasingly turn
the battle in your favor.

fields.JP:
戦闘中に#Icon[27]を押すと、
状態異常状態や発動中のトライジェイルを見ることができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press #Icon[27] during battle to check status
ailments and view the Jail Trial.
fields.EN:
Press #Icon[27] during battle to check status
ailments and active TriJail effects.

fields.JP:
ダンジョン内で行き詰ったら、#Icon[25]でザッピング画面に
切り替え、右下に「！？HELP」が有った場合は
他の主人公に切り替え、探索してみましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
When stuck, press #Icon[25] to visit the Zapping Screen.
If HELP? appears in the corner, then Zap to a new party
to progress in the dungeon.
fields.EN:
When stuck, press #Icon[25] to visit the Zapping Screen.
If HELP? appears in the corner, then Zap to a new party
to progress in the dungeon.

fields.JP:
ダストボックスを使うことで装備品や鍵を
受け渡すことができます。
fields.LOCALIZED: Use the Dustbox to store and take items.
fields.EN: Use the Dustbox to transfer equipment and keys.

fields.JP:
メアリスケルターシリーズには
各ナンバリングの公式ＨＰで見れる前日譚がある。
プレイ前、後ともに読むことをおすすめします。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each character has a backstory viewable from
the game's website. Light novels and other stories
are available for additional lore.
fields.EN:
The Mary Skelter series has prequels viewable on each numbered
title's official website. Reading them before or after playing
is recommended.

fields.JP:
神獄塔 メアリスケルターのもう一つの脱獄劇が記された
「神獄塔 メアリスケルター ～光の在処～」が
電撃文庫より刊行されている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Another Mary Skelter-related story, "Where the Light Goes," 
was published in Bunko Magazine.
fields.EN:
Another Mary Skelter escape story, "Where the Light Goes,"
was published by Dengeki Bunko.

fields.JP:
メアリスケルターシリーズはゲーム本編、前日譚、
文庫「神獄塔 メアリスケルター ～光の在処～」が
リンクした物語になっている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
All of the side-stories link with one another to complete the full 
Mary Skelter Story.
fields.EN:
The Mary Skelter series links the main games, their prequels,
and the novel "Where the Light Goes" into one story.

fields.JP:
神獄塔 メアリスケルターの際にジャック達が住んでいた地区。
ジェイルの危険から逃れた人々が比較的安全に暮らす地域。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The area where Jack and some of the others lived underground. It
was home to several human factions.
fields.EN:
The district where Jack and the others lived during Mary Skelter.
People who escaped the dangers of the Jail live there in
relative safety.

fields.JP:
解放地区内にあるジェイル脱獄を目指す組織。
ジャックや血式少女たちが所属している。
fields.LOCALIZED:
An organization centered around Jail research in the Liberated 
District. Jack and Alice once affiliated with them.
fields.EN:
An organization in the Liberated District aiming to escape
the Jail. Jack and the Blood Maidens belong to it.

fields.JP:
黎明にはジェイル研究者である十島博士、
血式武器を扱うハル、その助手のくらら、
救護班の上島視子、解放地区の門番の門脇永遠がいる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dawn consisted of Professor, Jail specialist, Haru, weapons maker,
 Clara, Haru's assistant, Miko Ueshima, medical specialist, and 
Towa Kadowaki, gatekeeper.
fields.EN:
Dawn includes Jail researcher Professor Toojima, Haru, Clara as
his assistant, rescue-team member Ueshima Miko, and Liberated
District gatekeeper Kadowaki Towa.

fields.JP:
元々黎明は博士、助手、隊長、棟梁、お母さん、先生
と呼ばれるメンバーで形成されていたが
ナイトメアに十島博士以外は殺されてしまう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Dawn was originally made up of the Professor, the Assistant, 
Leader, Chief, Mother, and Doctor.
fields.EN:
Dawn was originally formed by members called Professor, Assistant,
Captain, Chief, Mother, and Teacher, but all except Professor
Toojima were killed by a Nightmare.

fields.JP:
解放地区で貧困者への炊き出しから
社交場の提供、孤児院等を運営している団体。
教祖のミチルと副教祖の陽司（チアキ）がまとめている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Order of the Sun was a religious group which offered to feed 
the poor and house orphans. It was led by Oohime (Michiru) and 
Hitsuka (Chiaki).
fields.EN:
The Order of the Sun runs soup kitchens, social spaces, and an
orphanage in the Liberated District. It is led by Oohime (Michiru)
and deputy leader Hitsuka (Chiaki).

fields.JP:
「神獄塔 メアリスケルター」では存在しない"つう"、
亡くなっている"人魚姫"だが、とある出来事で
運命が変わり再び再会できた。
fields.LOCALIZED:
In Mary Skelter, certain events kept Otsuu from saving Little 
Mermaid. Their survival is thanks to a wish.
fields.EN:
Tsuu did not exist in Mary Skelter and Ningyohime was dead,
but a certain event changed their fate and allowed them to
meet again.

fields.JP:
グレーテルの兄でありナイトメア。
時に敵に時に仲間になった存在だが、
不運な流れにより死去している。ジャックに影響を与えた人物。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel, Gretel's brother, has been an ally and an enemy to the 
party. However, he died in an unfortunate turn of events.
fields.EN:
Hansel, Gretel's brother, has been an ally and an enemy to the 
party. However, he died in an unfortunate turn of events.

fields.JP:
殺されたマモル、ヒカリ、イツキ、カエデ、タクミは
初期黎明メンバーの武器に擬態することで、
初期黎明メンバーの記憶を引き継ぎ蘇る。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, Hikari, Itsuki, Kaede, and Takumi died, but were 
resurrected via mimicry, surviving with their original memories 
intact.
fields.EN:
Mamoru, Hikari, Itsuki, Kaede, and Takumi were killed, but by
mimicking the original Dawn members' weapons, they inherited
those members' memories and revived.

fields.JP: 【物語/フィナーレに続く物語】

ジェイルからの脱獄を果たし、かつ様々な困難を乗り越え
血式少女、つう達、マモル達と全員で地上へいくところから
物語は始まる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maidens escaped Jail along with Mamoru's group, 
Otsuu, Little Mermaid, and the others, thus beginning Mary Skelter 
Finale.
fields.EN:
The story begins after escaping the Jail and overcoming many
hardships, with the Blood Maidens, Tsuu, Mamoru's group, and
everyone else heading to the surface.

床から槍が飛び出てくる場所があるみたい。
痛そうね……
槍が床に引っ込んでいる時なら安全みたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some of these tiles activate spikes which shoot up from the 
ground. Looks painful. Seems safe to travel over the tiles 
if the spears are retracted.
fields.EN:
Some of these tiles activate spikes which shoot up from the 
ground. Looks painful. Seems safe to travel over the tiles 
if the spears are retracted.

fields.JP:
天井から刃が落ちてくる場所があるみたい。
刃が突然落ちて来るなんて怖くて仕方ないわね。
刃が上に戻る時に通っちゃいましょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Watch out for the dropping blades. Those could lop 
someone's head off. Let's pass once the blade is raised 
again.
fields.EN:
Watch out for the dropping blades. Those could lop 
someone's head off. Let's pass once the blade is raised 
again.

fields.JP:
う～ん、どこかにあるスイッチ？とかギミックとか？を
操作しないと開かない扉があるみたい。
辺りを探索して、怪しいモノがないか調べてみましょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. Is there a switch or lever anywhere? Scan the area for 
anything conspicuous.
fields.EN:
Hm. Is there a switch or lever anywhere? Scan the area for 
anything conspicuous.

fields.JP:
なにかセンサー？っていうのが出てて、
触れちゃうと攻撃を受けちゃうみたいね？
存在感が薄いと反応しないみたいだけどそんな力あったかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Must be some kind of sensor. If you trip the signal, it'll 
attack you. If only one of us could hide our presence 
somehow. Is that even possible?
fields.EN:
Must be some kind of sensor. If you trip the signal, it'll 
attack you. If only one of us could hide our presence 
somehow. Is that even possible?

fields.JP:
センサーに触れると勝手に扉が閉まっちゃう仕掛けがあるみたい。
その何かに触れないようにすれば扉は閉まらないみたいだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Activating this sensor opens the door. If you keep from 
touching it again, the door stays open.
fields.EN: Touching this sensor makes the door close automatically. As long as we don't touch it, the door should stay open.

fields.JP:
う～ん、どうやら私たちでは行けない場所にスイッチや
仕掛けがあるみたい。　これじゃ扉が開かないわね……
誰かがやってくれないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like there's a switch or gimmick preventing us from 
progressing. How do we open this door?
fields.EN: Looks like the switch or mechanism is somewhere we can't reach. The door won't open like this... Could someone else handle it for us?

fields.JP:
左右の天秤に何か置ける扉があるみたい。
天秤ってことはなにか置けるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like this scale controls the door's mechanism. Should 
we place something on either side?
fields.EN:
Looks like this scale controls the door's mechanism. Should 
we place something on either side?

fields.JP:
どうやら扉の中には一方からしか通過できない扉があるみたい。
辺りにスイッチなどが無い時は一方通行の扉かもしれませんわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some doors only open from one side. If there's no switch, 
we'll have to find another way in.
fields.EN:
Some doors only open from one side. If there's no switch, 
we'll have to find another way in.

fields.JP:
邪魔なブロックが存在してるみたい。
どうやら氷でできてるらしいけど、どうしたらいいかしら？
いっその事、壊しちゃうっていうのもありかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are some ice bricks blocking our path. Maybe we can 
smash them somehow.
fields.EN:
There are some ice bricks blocking our path. Maybe we can 
smash them somehow.

fields.JP:
天井からイナヅマが発生することがあるらしいの
怖いわねえ……
タイミングよく通過するのも良いけど、何か守ってくれる
力があるとより安全よね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bolts of lightning keep zapping from the ceiling. Good 
timing may get us across, but let's find something to
shield us from the bolts.
fields.EN:
Bolts of lightning keep zapping from the ceiling. Good 
timing may get us across, but let's find something to
shield us from the bolts.

fields.JP:
水が流れてて通れないところがあるみたい。
水の流れを止める方法があればいいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll have to stop the flow of water if we want to pass...
fields.EN: We'll have to stop the flow of water if we want to pass...

fields.JP:
炎じゃ溶けないカチカチの氷の扉があるみたい
鍵穴が見えるから、氷を解かす暖かい鍵があれば通れそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some doors are so frigid that they can't be melted with 
flames. I see a keyhole, so maybe there's some kind of warm 
key nearby to thaw the handle.
fields.EN: There are solid ice doors that won't melt with fire. I can see a keyhole, so a warm key that can melt the ice should get us through.

fields.JP:
不思議な水でできた扉があるみたい。
水量を減らせる、引き潮が関係している形の
カギがあれば通れるようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This odd door is reinforced with water somehow. Supposedly,
there's a tide key which can reduce the flow of water to 
let us pass.
fields.EN:
This odd door is reinforced with water somehow. Supposedly,
there's a tide key which can reduce the flow of water to 
let us pass.

fields.JP:
壁から大きなトゲが飛び出てくる場所があるみたい
トゲが引っ込んでいる時に行くしかなさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can only pass through here once the thorns are no longer 
protruding from the wall.
fields.EN:
We can only pass through here once the thorns are no longer 
protruding from the wall.

fields.JP:
鉄でできた邪魔なブロックがあるみたいね。
鉄でできてるから壊すことはできないし、
何かの力で引っ張れればいいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A steel block is preventing us from going through. We have 
to pull it out somehow...
fields.EN:
A steel block is preventing us from going through. We have 
to pull it out somehow...

fields.JP:
乗ると大きくジャンプできるトランポリンがあるみたい！
楽しそうだわ～
もっと加速したら遠くまでいけそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Supposedly there's a trampoline we can launch from. That 
looks so fun! With more speed, we could probably launch 
even further.
fields.EN:
Supposedly there's a trampoline we can launch from. That 
looks so fun! With more speed, we could probably launch 
even further.

fields.JP:
毒の沼なんてモノがあるみたいね。
もちろん入ると怪我しちゃうから気を付けましょうね
fields.LOCALIZED: This swamp seems poisonous. Be careful, okay?
fields.EN: This swamp seems poisonous. Be careful, okay?

fields.JP:
こんな場所にゴミ捨て場があるなんて不思議ね～
使わないアイテムや武器とかここに入れちゃいましょうか。
捨てたものはどこにいくのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Odd to find a dustbox here. Store unwanted items and 
weapons here. You never know when they'll come in handy...
fields.EN: Strange to find a garbage dump here. Maybe we should throw away unused items and weapons here. I wonder where the things we discard end up?

fields.JP:
どうやら大きな穴が合って通れない場所があるみたい
何か穴をふさぐモノが出せないかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's a huge chasm we can't cross. Maybe we can fill it 
somehow.
fields.EN:
There's a huge chasm we can't cross. Maybe we can fill it 
somehow.

fields.JP:
監獄塔の中には小さな炎が所々あるみたいね
小さい炎だからなにか冷たいモノをかければ消えちゃいそうね
中には先に進めるための仕掛けもあるみたい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are small flames littered throughout the tower. Maybe 
we can use them to melt cold things. What's the secret...?
fields.EN: There are small flames throughout the Jail Tower. Since they're small, something cold might put them out. Some may even be mechanisms needed to proceed.

fields.JP:
ろうそくがある場所があるみたい。
ろうそくだから火があれば灯すことができるわね。
でも、メアリーのマッチを使うのはダメだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Find a way to light all those candles
without using one of Mary's matches!
fields.EN:
Find a way to light all those candles
without using one of Mary's matches!

fields.JP:
手で押せない遠くの場所にスイッチがあるみたいなの。
なにかモノを遠くに飛ばす方法はないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see a lever off in the distance, but none of us can reach
it. Think someone could shoot something at it to trigger 
it?
fields.EN:
I see a lever off in the distance, but none of us can reach
it. Think someone could shoot something at it to trigger 
it?

fields.JP: 道をふさぐ壊せそうな物体

邪魔なひび割れた物体が所々に視えるわね。
何か大きな力や爆発で破壊できないかしらね
ってそれはちょっと物騒すぎかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see cracks in several places. Maybe we
could detonate our way through?
fields.EN:
I see cracks in several places. Maybe we
could detonate our way through?

fields.JP:
金網の壁が視えるわね。
何か切れるモノがあれば壊すことができそうね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see a wiremesh wall. Maybe we can cut through somehow.
fields.EN: I see a wiremesh wall. Maybe we can cut through somehow.

fields.JP:
振り子みたいに動いているロープね
タイミングよく飛び移れば向こうまで渡れるかしら？
楽しそうだわ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
The rope's swinging like a pendulum. Time your jump to 
cross!
fields.EN:
The rope's swinging like a pendulum. Time your jump to 
cross!

fields.JP:
ずいぶん大きな鉄骨ね
手は届かないけど、何かで上につかまれば、
向こう側まで渡れるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This large steel frame is too big to scale. There has to 
someway to reach the other side...
fields.EN: It's a huge steel frame. We can't reach it by hand, but if we could grab onto it with something, maybe we could cross to the other side.

fields.JP:
細い鎖を使わなきゃ通れない場所があるみたいね
お姉さんうまくバランスとれるかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we can use this tightrope to cross. I wonder if 
we can balance well enough.
fields.EN:
Looks like we can use this tightrope to cross. I wonder if 
we can balance well enough.

fields.JP:
どうやらスイッチを押して少ししたら閉じちゃう扉があるみたい。
上手に最短ルートをいくか、何か早く動く方法があるといいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like there's a door that will close in seconds after 
you push the switch. We have to use the shortest route or 
move fast.
fields.EN:
Seems like there's a door that will close in seconds after 
you push the switch. We have to use the shortest route or 
move fast.

fields.JP:
今度は厄介なことにセンサーに触れるとメルヒェンが出て来ちゃう
仕掛けがあるみたい。
いちいち相手になんてしてられないから気づかれずに進みたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This time, there's a sensor that summons a Marchen on 
touch. Triggering it too often is dangerous, so let's find 
a way around.
fields.EN:
This time, there's a sensor that summons a Marchen on 
touch. Triggering it too often is dangerous, so let's find 
a way around.

fields.JP:
床にスイッチのある場所があるみたい。
ブロックとか上にのせればいいんだろうけど、
ない場合どうしましょう……何か置けるモノがあればいいけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like there's a ground switch to trigger the door's 
mechanism. If we had a block, we could place it there, but 
what if we don't...?
fields.EN:
Looks like there's a ground switch to trigger the door's 
mechanism. If we had a block, we could place it there, but 
what if we don't...?

fields.JP: 炎の中にたまにアイテムがあるみたいね
fields.EN: It looks like there are sometimes items inside the flames.

fields.JP:
通過しようとすると怪我しちゃう扉があるみたい！
怖い扉ね……。
怪我しないように攻撃から身を守ってくれる何かがないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This door damages anyone who passes through. Find a way to 
prevent further damage.
fields.EN:
This door damages anyone who passes through. Find a way to 
prevent further damage.

fields.JP:
監獄塔の中には結構壊せる障害物があるみたい。
切れるモノ、壊せるモノ、燃やせるモノがあるみたいだから
色々試してみるのもありね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we can cut our way through this
place. Try slashing, burning, or breaking
through obstacles. Time to experiment!
fields.EN:
Looks like we can cut our way through this
place. Try slashing, burning, or breaking
through obstacles. Time to experiment!

fields.JP:
壁から矢が飛んでくる物騒な場所があるみたい。
スイッチをオフにすると止まるみたいだけど、
何か怪我しないような力はないかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Supposedly, there are some areas with panels that shoot 
arrows from the wall. They can only be disabled with a 
switch. Gotta find it...
fields.EN: There are dangerous places where arrows shoot from the walls. They stop if you turn the switch off, but is there some power that can keep us from getting hurt?

fields.JP:
その床に立つと滑って進行方向にどんどん進む場所があるみたい。
制御するのが大変そうだから、マップを見ながら
慎重に進みたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Careful. The ground here is slippery. Take one step, and 
you'll slide across the room. Best to check the map ahead 
of time to plot your course.
fields.EN:
Careful. The ground here is slippery. Take one step, and 
you'll slide across the room. Best to check the map ahead 
of time to plot your course.

fields.JP:
今度はセンサーに触れると矢が飛んでくる場所があるみたい
あの手この手でいやんなっちゃうわね～
なんとかセンサーに気づかれずに進みたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Another wall that fires arrows if you trigger the sensor. 
This is getting to be too much...
fields.EN: This time, arrows fire when the sensor detects us. This is getting ridiculous... Let's find a way through without being detected.

fields.JP:
センサーに触れると警報アラームがなる場所があるみたい
メルヒェンが多く出現するようになっちゃいそうね……
なんとかセンサーに気づかれずに進みたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Touching the sensor activates the alarm. Best to avoid 
detection.
fields.EN: Touching the sensor sets off an alarm, which seems to make more Marchen appear. Let's find a way through without being detected.

fields.JP:
なんと、見えない消えちゃう壁があるみたいなの！
道の形も変わっちゃうみたいだから迷わない様に慎重に
マップをみて進みたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's an invisible wall here. When it disappears, the 
path changes shape, so check the map often.
fields.EN:
There's an invisible wall here. When it disappears, the 
path changes shape, so check the map often.

fields.JP:
不気味な蝋人形がいるみたい見かけたら気を付けなきゃね
何かで壊したりできないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: This wax doll is creepy. Can we break it somehow?
fields.EN: This wax doll is creepy. Can we break it somehow?

fields.JP: 矢の進行方向が変わるギミック

弓矢の進行方向を変えるモノがあるみたいね
うまく使いこなせば届かないモノも射ることができるかも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like there's a wall that changes the direction of 
arrows shot at it. Maybe we can use this somehow.
fields.EN:
Seems like there's a wall that changes the direction of 
arrows shot at it. Maybe we can use this somehow.

fields.JP:
どうやら「槍の出る床」怪我させちゃう仕掛けは、
スイッチを操作することで止まることがあるみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There must be a lever to prevent the spikes from shooting 
out.
fields.EN: It seems some damaging traps, like the spear floors, can be stopped by operating a switch.

fields.JP: キャンペーン特典一式
とうとうこの時と思いきや……
fields.LOCALIZED: I thought it was finally time....
fields.EN: I thought it was finally time....

fields.JP: 神獄塔 メアリスケルター

キャンペーン特典として
恋獄塔 めありーすけるたー　true endが
タイトル画面で選べるようになりました。
fields.LOCALIZED: The "Mary Skelter: Locked Up in Love - True End" can now be accessed from the menu.
fields.EN: The campaign bonus "Mary Skelter: Locked Up in Love - True End" can now be selected from the title screen.

fields.JP:
キャンペーン特典として浄化風立ち絵イラストが
BONUSのギャラリーに追加されました。
fields.LOCALIZED: View all images unlocked by the "Purification Gallery Unlock" in the BONUS menu.
fields.EN: Campaign-bonus Purification-style standing illustrations were added to the BONUS Gallery.

浄化風イラスト・シャーロット
浄化風イラスト・アリス

fields.LOCALIZED: Mary Skelter: Locked Up in Love - True End
fields.EN: Mary Skelter: Locked Up in Love - True End Flag Unlock DLC

fields.JP:
防御や速さにやや難があるが、ブラッドス
ケルター時に味方を攻撃しづらく、ジェノ
サイドモード時にＴＥＣが上昇する。
回復役。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A medic-based job with low DEF
and AGI that makes it tougher for
foes to hit allies in Massacre Mode.
fields.EN:
A healer with somewhat low DEF and AGI.
Less likely to attack allies in Blood Skelter,
and TEC rises in Genocide Mode.

fields.LOCALIZED:
Restore a small amount
of the target's HP
fields.EN:
Restore a small amount
of the target's HP

fields.JP:
詠唱なく敵全体に
風属性の小ダメージを与える
